## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Also describe relevant motivation and context.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature / animation (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (wiring guide, setup guide, or README)

## Hardware Verification
- [ ] Tested on physical Arduino UNO R3 hardware
- [ ] Verified OLED (SSD1306) display rendering
- [ ] Verified sensor behavior (Tilt switch, LDR, DHT11)
- [ ] Verified Flash and SRAM consumption within limits (< 30 KB Flash, < 1.7 KB SRAM)

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new compiler warnings
